description: This Java class defines an immutable event named SubjectCreated that extends AbstractPolicyEvent and implements PolicyEvent. It represents an event triggered after a Subject is created within the policies component of the Eclipse Ditto project. The class includes methods for creating instances from JSON, getters for its attributes, and logic for JSON serialization. It contains static definitions for JSON fields related to 'label' and 'subject'.

classes.name: SubjectCreated
